body:
At the critical density exponent, a bounded total moment alone permits collapsing normalized transfer gaps. This candidate gives an explicit dimension-free gap under one uniform critical-tail cutoff and identifies the nonvanishing tail in the exact-budget counterexample. It replaces strict power-exponent slack by an additional tail assumption; it does not remove all integrability assumptions or claim uniform integrability is necessary.

Judges were committed first at 493d0aa62345fe537b7414f7cbc8d2a01d16b636 after disclosed preparatory reasoning. Candidate source 14f6c1afda58d925cdf1481ecb7791d0ade9395b contains the full analytical proof and primary-source comparison with classical operator-tail criteria. External priority remains unresolved. No local mathematical execution or new PDF grade. Separate source audit and required checks must pass before normal merge; preserve the audited SHA unchanged. This is a grouped extension of the existing transfer work, not a separate paper.
